name: Card Acquisition Request 3
definition: Data to request to card data acquisition.

SaleTransactionIdentification.name: Sale Transaction Identification
SaleTransactionIdentification.definition: Sale System identification of the transaction in an unambiguous way.

AllowedPaymentBrand.name: Allowed Payment Brand
AllowedPaymentBrand.definition: Card payment brands allowed by the Sale System for the payment transaction.

AllowedLoyaltyBrand.name: Allowed Loyalty Brand
AllowedLoyaltyBrand.definition: Loyalty brands or programs allowed by the Sale System for the loyalty transaction.

ForceCustomerSelectionFlag.name: Force Customer Selection Flag
ForceCustomerSelectionFlag.definition: Indicates if the Customer realises the selection of the card application.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Amount of the transaction. It allows the processing of a contactless card.

SaleToPOIData.name: Sale To POI Data
SaleToPOIData.definition: The POI System receives this information.

SaleToAcquirerData.name: Sale To Acquirer Data
SaleToAcquirerData.definition: Sale information intended for the Acquirer.

SaleToIssuerData.name: Sale To Issuer Data
SaleToIssuerData.definition: Sale information intended for the Issuer.
